notes: Corrected the two hoios clauses: the accepted alignment gave the supplied copula to ho choikos and ho epouranios citing rule 96, but rule 96 speaks of an article inside the predicate phrase, and here the articular adjective is the clause's subject while hoios is the predicate. Rule 63 puts the copula on the predicate even against inverted English order, which is also how the answering toioutoi clauses were already analysed, so rule 24 requires the two halves of each correlative to match.
The articles keep only their own the under rule 19; nothing else in the phrase competes for a determiner.
